name: harnessim
description: Connects Claude Code to HarnessIM, surfaces new messages on every prompt, and wakes an idle session when someone messages the agent.

api_key.title: HarnessIM API key (optional, for wake-on-message)
api_key.description: An hk_ key from HarnessIM → Settings → API keys, ideally pinned to this agent's identity. Only the background watcher uses it, to wake an idle session when a message arrives. Sign-in for the tools themselves happens in your browser on first use.
